title: Start-Stop Generator
text: Generate start-stop signal used by signal generation, estimation, and autotuning blocks, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Settling time interval} sets tling time interval; {Sample time (Ts)}, {Data Type} sets the floating point precision, {Source of start time points}, {Duration (sec)} sets the start-stop signal duration, {Number of samples after reaching steady-state to generate start-stop signal} sets the delay for starting signal generation, {Settling time upper bounds} sets the upper bound for settling time and {Settling time lower bounds} sets the lower bound for settling time. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: enable
ports.summary: Enable and disable start-stop signal generation scalar

params.name: Source of start time points
params.values: Source of start time points External time vector (default) | Time after reaching steady-state

params.name: Number of samples after reaching steady-state to generate start-stop signal
params.values: Delay for starting signal generation 2 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Settling time upper bounds
params.values: Upper bound for settling time [1.1 2.1 3.1] (default) | vector

params.name: Settling time lower bounds
params.values: Lower bound for settling time [0.9 1.9 2.9] (default) | vector
